$comment: Animal Friends: First Boroughs (AF-STARTER-01). Authoritative card data for the prototype. Effects use the vocabulary interpreted by src/engine/effects.js; 'text' is the player-facing rules text. The named cards are examples; the schema is the contract.
name: Animal Friends: First Boroughs

decks.name: Burrow & Bloom
decks.blurb: Rabbits and Mice of Agriculture and Botany: efficient shifts, recruiting, growth and Event synergy.

decks.name: Paws & Papers
decks.blurb: Raccoons and Foxes of Commerce and Civics: market contests, card flow and controlled disruption.

decks.name: Bramble & Bristle
decks.blurb: Hedgehogs and Badgers of Crafts and Agriculture: steady shifts, protection from Unemployment, and friends brought back to work.

decks.name: Ripple & Rune
decks.blurb: Otters and Squirrels of Lore and Commerce: deck sculpting, Market Deck peeks and bids that pay you back.

cards.name: Clover
cards.title: Seedling Helper
cards.text: Recruit: if you have another Agriculture Character, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Small paws, big watering can, and the first green shoots of spring.

cards.name: Clover
cards.title: Community Gardener
cards.text: Upgrades Clover. Recruit: choose another Agriculture Character you control; it becomes upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Clover transforms a meadow into a lush, thriving garden.

cards.name: Mabel
cards.title: Seed Keeper
cards.text: The first Event you play each turn that requires an Agriculture Character gives you 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Mabel carefully saves seeds for next season's planting.

cards.name: Mabel
cards.title: Horticulturist
cards.text: Upgrades Mabel. Busy: the next Event you play this turn requires one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Mabel knows the secret language of all growing things.

cards.name: Poppy
cards.title: Postmaster
cards.text: When you announce a purchase with Poppy while she is your only upright Rabbit, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Poppy hops from burrow to burrow with important letters.

cards.name: Poppy
cards.title: Civic Planner
cards.text: Upgrades Poppy. Your challenge bids win ties.
cards.flavor: Poppy shapes the town's future with her wise decisions.

cards.name: Fern
cards.title: Forager
cards.text: When Fern becomes upright, you may put an Event from your Town Dump on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavor: Fern ventures into the forest, gathering nature's gifts.

cards.name: Fern
cards.title: Ecologist
cards.text: Upgrades Fern. The first Event you play each turn also gives you 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Fern understands the woodland's deepest rhythms and needs.

cards.name: Community Garden
cards.text: Requires an Agriculture Character. Gain 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Friends gather to plant seeds and share their harvest.

cards.name: Seed Swap
cards.text: Requires a Rabbit and a Mouse. Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card, and gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Rabbits and Mice exchange precious seeds and stories.

cards.name: Patient Harvest
cards.text: Requires a Botany Character. Limited 2: the first shift you complete each turn produces 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Time passes slowly; the garden rewards those who wait.

cards.name: Neighborhood Watch
cards.text: Requires a Civics Character. Rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Neighbors look after one another with gentle vigilance.

cards.name: Blooming Confidence
cards.text: Requires two Rabbits. Ready one of your Characters and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: One brave blossom opens, and the whole hedgerow follows.

cards.name: Welcome Wagon
cards.text: Requires a Mouse. Recruit a cost-0 Character from your hand for free; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: The town greets its newest friend with warm welcome.

cards.name: Patch
cards.title: Recycling Scout
cards.text: Recruit: look at the top two cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Clever Patch finds hidden treasures in forgotten places.

cards.name: Patch
cards.title: Town Auditor
cards.text: Upgrades Patch. When an opponent challenges one of your purchases, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Patch keeps the town's affairs honest and balanced.

cards.name: Juniper
cards.title: Messenger
cards.text: When Juniper starts a shift, you may pay 1 Supply to raise one of your open bids by 1.
cards.flavor: No letter is too urgent for a Fox with quick paws and a quicker grin.

cards.name: Juniper
cards.title: Diplomat
cards.text: Upgrades Juniper. Your opponent cannot raise a pending bid.
cards.flavor: Juniper brings understanding and peace between old friends.

cards.name: Hazel
cards.title: Market Vendor
cards.text: While Hazel is upright, your first purchase announcement each turn may bid 1 less than the card's cost.
cards.flavor: Hazel arranges her market stall with care and pride.

cards.name: Hazel
cards.title: Merchant
cards.text: Upgrades Hazel. Whenever you gain a non-Statue Market card, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Hazel has become a trusted merchant of all the land.

cards.name: Rowan
cards.title: Records Clerk
cards.text: Whenever a card effect sends any Character to Unemployment, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Rowan writes everything down in her neat leather journal.

cards.name: Rowan
cards.title: Ombudsperson
cards.text: Upgrades Rowan. Busy: until your next turn, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: Rowan ensures everyone's voice is heard and honored.

cards.name: Open Ledger
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character. Gain 2 Supply and look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Every coin counted twice, every promise written down once.

cards.name: Paper Trail
cards.text: Requires a Raccoon and a Fox. Draw 2 cards. Your opponent puts a card from their hand on top of their deck.
cards.flavor: Raccoon and Fox uncover the truth through careful inquiry.

cards.name: Civic Rally
cards.text: Requires a Civics Character. Limited 2: your first bid each turn counts as 1 higher.
cards.flavor: The town gathers to speak its mind and make decisions.

cards.name: Rumor Control
cards.text: Requires a Fox. Draw 1 card. Until your next turn, opponent effects cannot make you discard or lose Supply.
cards.flavor: Whispers fade fast when a clever Fox sets the record straight.

cards.name: Fair Hearing
cards.text: Requires two Civics Characters. Rehire a Character from your Unemployment for free and draw 2 cards. Your opponent gains 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Justice finds its way through reasoned debate and mercy.

cards.name: Market Day
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character. Limited 2: your first purchase announcement each turn draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: Everyone gathers to trade, talk, and make their bids.

cards.name: Statue of Kindness
cards.text: At the start of your turn, if you have no more Characters in Unemployment than your opponent, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Carved with open paws, it warms the whole square on cold mornings.

cards.name: Statue of Curiosity
cards.text: On gain: draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Its stone eyes follow whoever wonders loudest what lies beyond the hill.

cards.name: Statue of Courage
cards.text: Your next challenge bid costs 1 less Supply to pay.
cards.flavor: A monument to those who face their fears bravely.

cards.name: Statue of Patience
cards.text: Your Masters enter play with one fewer orientation delay (they enter Busy instead of at 180°).
cards.flavor: Moss grows on its shoulders, and it does not mind one bit.

cards.name: Statue of Generosity
cards.text: On gain: give your opponent 1 Supply and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: A statue with open arms, sharing freely with all.

cards.name: Statue of Ingenuity
cards.text: Once per turn, an Event you play requires one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Stone shaped to celebrate clever paws and minds.

cards.name: Statue of Community
cards.text: If you control Characters of at least three species, the first shift you complete each turn produces 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Standing strong together, a monument to unity.

cards.name: Statue of Harmony
cards.text: Whenever a purchase you are part of resolves with a tied bid, ready one of your Characters at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: A peaceful figure, bringing all voices into accord.

cards.name: Statue of Joy
cards.text: On gain: ready up to two of your Apprentices.
cards.flavor: Carved in laughter, capturing happiness forever.

cards.name: Town Charter
cards.text: The first Character you recruit before your next turn costs 1 less.
cards.flavor: The founding promise that binds this town together.

cards.name: Festival Grant
cards.text: Gain 4 Supply.
cards.flavor: Gold for celebration, music, and merry gatherings.

cards.name: Emergency Reserve
cards.text: Prevent up to 3 Supply you would lose to opponent effects. Goes Out of Play.
cards.flavor: Saved supplies for when hardship comes unexpectedly.

cards.name: Mayor's Seal
cards.text: Your next purchase announcement cannot be challenged.
cards.flavor: The mayor's official mark of protection and authority.

cards.name: Library Annex
cards.text: Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: A room full of stories, wisdom, and forgotten lore.

cards.name: Quiet Mediation
cards.text: The next challenge against one of your purchases is cancelled; your bid stays open.
cards.flavor: A space for calm voices to settle hot disputes.

cards.name: Poacher's Pardon
cards.text: Send an opponent's Character to Unemployment, then discard 2 cards. (Cannot target a Character that has not yet been upright on its owner's turn.)
cards.flavor: The cage door swings open, but somebody still has to answer for it.

cards.name: Town Bell
cards.text: Ready one of your Apprentices.
cards.flavor: It rings to gather townsfolk for news and celebration.

cards.name: Supply Depot
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Carefully stored goods for the town's daily needs.

cards.name: Public Gardens
cards.text: The next shift you complete produces 2 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Flourishing beds of green that feed and gladden.

cards.name: Courier Network
cards.text: Look at the top five cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Swift paws connect the far reaches of the realm.

cards.name: Community Kitchen
cards.text: Rehire a cost-1 Character from your Unemployment for free; it enters upright.
cards.flavor: A heart of warmth where friends share meals daily.

cards.name: Appeal Board
cards.text: Your next rehire costs 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Second chances and reconsideration for those wronged.

cards.name: Scrap Yard
cards.text: You may discard a card to send an opponent's Character with cost 2 or less to Unemployment. (Cannot target a Character that has not yet been upright on its owner's turn.)
cards.flavor: A place of salvage where nothing goes to waste.

cards.name: Town Archives
cards.text: Return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand. Goes Out of Play.
cards.flavor: Ancient records holding the town's true history.

cards.name: Town Clock
cards.text: At the start of your next turn, advance all your Characters one extra orientation step.
cards.flavor: Its bells hurry the whole town along, one extra tick at a time.

cards.name: Bramble
cards.title: Tinker
cards.text: Recruit: if you have another Crafts Character, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Bramble can mend anything, given string, wax and an afternoon.

cards.name: Bramble
cards.title: Master Joiner
cards.text: Upgrades Bramble. The first shift you complete each turn produces 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Every beam in the new town hall fits without a single nail.

cards.name: Thistle
cards.title: Field Hand
cards.text: When Thistle becomes upright, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Up before the lanterns, home after the moon.

cards.name: Thistle
cards.title: Grange Warden
cards.text: Upgrades Thistle. Busy: rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Nobody is left standing outside the grange in Thistle’s season.

cards.name: Quill
cards.title: Orchard Keeper
cards.text: When Quill starts a shift, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: She prunes the orchard the way other folk tidy a bookshelf.

cards.name: Quill
cards.title: Harvest Steward
cards.text: Upgrades Quill. Your Masters arrive one turn sooner.
cards.flavor: Quill has the whole harvest planned before the first frost lifts.

cards.name: Moss
cards.title: Toolsmith
cards.text: Recruit: your next rehire costs 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: A good tool, Moss says, is a favour you lend to tomorrow.

cards.name: Moss
cards.title: Bridgewright
cards.text: Upgrades Moss. Busy: ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Three boroughs, one river, and Moss’s stubborn arches between them.

cards.name: Barn Raising
cards.text: Requires two Crafts Characters. Gain 2 Supply and ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: The whole borough turns up; the roof is on by supper.

cards.name: Mended Fences
cards.text: Requires a Badger. Rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 1 less Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A quiet apology, a new rail, and the gate swings true again.

cards.name: Winter Stores
cards.text: Requires an Agriculture Character. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Root cellars full, shelves labelled, and nobody hungry in the thaw.

cards.name: Workshop Swap
cards.text: Requires a Crafts Character and a Hedgehog. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. Your next recruit costs 1 less.
cards.flavor: Everyone leaves with someone else’s half-finished project.

cards.name: Hedgerow Guard
cards.text: Requires a Hedgehog. Until your next turn, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment and opponent effects cannot make you discard or lose Supply.
cards.flavor: Spines out, lanterns lit, and the hedgerow keeps its own.

cards.name: Tool Lending Day
cards.text: Requires a Crafts Character. Ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Borrow the plane, return the plane, and stay for tea.

cards.name: Pip
cards.title: Story Collector
cards.text: Recruit: look at the top two cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Pip trades in rumours, and pays in better ones.

cards.name: Pip
cards.title: Archivist
cards.text: Upgrades Pip. When Pip becomes upright, you may return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand.
cards.flavor: Nothing is ever really lost; it is only filed somewhere clever.

cards.name: Willow
cards.title: Ferry Trader
cards.text: When Willow starts a shift, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: She is paid twice: once in coin, once in gossip from the far bank.

cards.name: Willow
cards.title: Harbourmaster
cards.text: Upgrades Willow. Whenever you gain a non-Statue Capital City card, gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: Every crate on the quay has already been counted by Willow.

cards.name: Tansy
cards.title: Lamplighter
cards.text: When Tansy becomes upright, look at the top three cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: She knows which street will want light before the dusk does.

cards.name: Tansy
cards.title: Loremaster
cards.text: Upgrades Tansy. At the start of your turn, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Tansy reads the town the way a river reads its own banks.

cards.name: Acorn
cards.title: Stall Runner
cards.text: While Acorn is upright, your first bid each turn counts as 1 higher.
cards.flavor: Acorn can be at three stalls at once, and usually is.

cards.name: Acorn
cards.title: Guild Broker
cards.text: Upgrades Acorn. When an opponent challenges one of your purchases, gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Every challenge is just another fee, politely collected.

cards.name: River Market
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character. Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Barges tie up two deep and the whole bank smells of hot pastry.

cards.name: Told by Lamplight
cards.text: Requires a Lore Character. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, look at the top two cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: The story goes long, and everyone stays for the end of it.

cards.name: Acorn Cache
cards.text: Requires a Squirrel. Gain 2 Supply and your next recruit costs 1 less.
cards.flavor: Buried last autumn, remembered — mostly — this spring.

cards.name: Rune Reading
cards.text: Requires a Lore Character and an Otter. Draw 3 cards, then discard 2 cards, and look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: The stones say: fortune, and also, mind the third step.

cards.name: Ferry Charter
cards.text: Requires an Otter. Ready one of your Characters; a working Character finishes its shift.
cards.flavor: Signed, stamped, and away before the ink is dry.

cards.name: Hushed Agreement
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character and a Lore Character. Limited 2: your challenge bids win ties.
cards.flavor: No shouting, no banners — just two paws shaken behind the archive.

cards.name: Towpath
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: A good path, a patient rope, and the barge comes home.

cards.name: Lamplighter's Round
cards.text: Look at the top three cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Every lamp lit in order, and the order is never an accident.

cards.name: Seed Exchange
cards.text: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Two handfuls in, one handful out, and everyone plants something new.

cards.name: River Ferry
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Tuppence a crossing, and the news is thrown in free.

cards.name: Shared Toolshed
cards.text: The next shift you complete produces 1 extra Supply, and you draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Sign the slate, take the saw, bring it back sharp.

cards.name: Common Pasture
cards.text: Rehire a Character costing 2 or less from your Unemployment for free; it enters upright.
cards.flavor: There is always room on the common for one more pair of paws.

cards.name: Story Circle
cards.text: Put an Event from your Town Dump on the bottom of your deck and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Told once more, a little truer, and back into the pile it goes.

cards.name: Harvest Fair
cards.text: Gain 5 Supply. Your opponent gains 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Ribbons for the marrows, and nobody goes home empty-pawed.

cards.name: Guild Hall
cards.text: Recruit a Character costing 2 or less from your hand for free; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: Apprentices sworn in beneath the old crossed hammers.

cards.name: Night Watch
cards.text: Until your next turn, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: Two lanterns, one route, and a very determined badger.

cards.name: Watermill
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply, and the next shift you complete produces 2 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: The wheel turns whether or not anyone is watching it.

cards.name: Ledger Audit
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Your opponent puts a card from their hand on top of their deck.
cards.flavor: Column by column, until the awkward entry surfaces.

cards.name: Mason's Yard
cards.text: Ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Dust, chisels, and the patient shaping of a town.

cards.name: Festival Parade
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Drums down the high street and bunting on every rail.

cards.name: Old Boundary Stone
cards.text: Send an opponent's Character with cost 3 or less to Unemployment. Goes Out of Play. (Cannot target a Character that has not yet been upright on its owner's turn.)
cards.flavor: Older than the charter, and far less willing to argue.

cards.name: Beacon Hill
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply and ready two of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Light it and three boroughs answer before the hour is out.

marketDeck.$comment: Every Statue is always in the Market Deck; `poolSize` Capital City cards are drawn at random from `pool` each game, so the deck keeps its 25-card shape while the display varies between games. A plain array of card ids is still accepted.
